## What changes for a group

<!-- In plain words: what someone using the site will notice, and why. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint` pass
- [ ] A group with one kind of night, no events channels or no Claude key still reads right (if it touches those)
- [ ] New settings are in `src/config.ts`, `.env.example` and the README
- [ ] The How it works page and `docs/how-it-works.md` match any changed number or rule
- [ ] Schema changes are additive
